Name: BirdMan's Armory
Author: HempyBirdMan
Description:
[center]﻿Greetings and salutations comrades, today we rejoice as I bring my first and only mod!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/90DNnSGV/title2.png[/img]﻿﻿

That is right today my endeavours into figuring out how pixel art works comes to fruition in the form of 6 new weapons, cooked up from the craterous depths that were once my mind and inspired by a lot of fantastical mods hitting the scene lately!

Each of these comes with an added bonus of relieving you of your hard earned cash at the Adventurer Shoppe, (we are working out Marlon's retirement fund, let us say?), plus at the end of the day is any price really to steep when it comes to protecting you and your potential 1-8 partners/roommates? Not to mention they should get you where you need to go when it comes to stats, and one even has custom sounds and projectile, wowie?! Both the custom sounds and the projectile, can be disabled via the usual config options, as it may be overbearing, probably gonna look into that.

Requires the standard ole'reliable Content Patcher.

I am very excited to bring you this, and appreciate any and all feedback on how to improve the art or anything at all for this or moving forward with mods.

While they did not directly help shout out to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url] whose weapon recolors served as base guide for a lot of the work on a few of these, and inspired the Moon Stick weapon when I saw their beautiful moon weapon. Check out their work it's all the awesomest of sauce!﻿ [/center]
